mapper.select: select v.version_id from tl_tag_library l join dp_dataset d on d.dataset_id = l.dataset_id and d.del_flag = '0' and d.status = '0' join dp_dataset_version v on v.dataset_id = d.dataset_id and v.version_status = 'ONLINE' where l.library_id = #{libraryId} and l.del_flag = '0' order by (v.version_id = d.default_version_id) desc, v.version_no desc limit 1
select definition_json from dp_dataset_version where version_id = #{versionId}
select object_name from dp_meta_table where table_id = #{tableId}
select c.column_name from dp_dataset_field f join dp_meta_column c on c.column_id = f.source_column_id where f.version_id = #{versionId} and f.field_alias = #{fieldAlias} and f.enabled = '1' limit 1
select c.column_name from dp_dataset_field f join dp_meta_column c on c.column_id = f.source_column_id where f.version_id = #{versionId} and f.enabled = '1' and c.is_pk = '1' limit 1
select dataset_id from tl_tag_library where library_id = #{libraryId} and del_flag = '0'

select ds.datasource_id as datasourceId, ds.catalog_id as catalogId, ds.order_num as orderNum, ds.source_name as sourceName, ds.source_type as sourceType, ds.host, ds.port, ds.database_name as databaseName, ds.username, ds.password_cipher as passwordCipher, ds.db_version as dbVersion, ds.use_pool as usePool, ds.use_ssl as useSsl, ds.ca_cert as caCert, ds.jdbc_params as jdbcParams, ds.status, ds.usage_count as usageCount, ds.last_sync_time as lastSyncTime, ds.last_sync_status as lastSyncStatus, ds.last_error_msg as lastErrorMsg, ds.del_flag as delFlag, ds.create_by as createBy, ds.create_time as createTime, ds.update_by as updateBy, ds.update_time as updateTime, ds.remark from dp_dataset d join dp_datasource ds on ds.datasource_id = d.datasource_id and ds.del_flag = '0' where d.dataset_id = #{datasetId}
select tag_name from tl_tag where library_id = #{libraryId} and field_name = #{fieldName} and del_flag = '0' limit 1
select tag_type from tl_tag where library_id = #{libraryId} and field_name = #{fieldName} and del_flag = '0' limit 1

select d.dimension_id as dimensionId, d.dimension_name as dimensionName, d.source_table_name as sourceTableName, d.datasource_id as datasourceId from tl_tag_library_dimension r join dp_dimension_table d on d.dimension_id = r.dimension_id join tl_tag_library l on l.library_id = r.library_id and l.del_flag = '0' join dp_dataset ds on ds.dataset_id = l.dataset_id where r.library_id = #{libraryId} and d.status = '0' and d.del_flag = '0' and d.datasource_id = ds.datasource_id order by r.order_num, r.relation_id
